result.title: kce netlist intent
result.description: A schematic described by its netlist: which components exist with which fields, which pins belong on which net, which pins are unconnected, and which nets need a power flag. `kce sch apply` makes a schematic match this file; `kce sch verify --expect` compares KiCad's own netlist with it. Nets are matched by their pin sets, so KiCad's auto-generated net names do not matter. The no_connect, power_flags and remove keys are optional additions to version 1.

components.description: Every component in the design, by reference designator. Power symbols and PWR_FLAGs are not components.

nets.description: Nets by pin membership. A pin may belong to one net only.

no_connect.description: Pins that must carry a no-connect flag (REF:PIN). A no-connect pin belongs to no net. `sch apply` places the flags idempotently.

power_flags.description: Pins whose nets need a PWR_FLAG. `sch apply` places the flag on that pin, idempotently.

remove.description: References the design must not contain. `sch apply` deletes them unless --patch is given; `sch verify` reports any that are still present.

footprint.description: Footprint id, e.g. Resistor_SMD:R_0805_2012Metric. Omitted: left as it is.

value.description: Value field. Omitted: left as it is.

fields.description: Extra symbol fields by name (MPN, LCSC, ...). Omitted fields are left as they are.

uuid.description: Symbol uuid; set on the placed symbol.

at.description: Placement [x, y] in mm. Omitted: a deterministic free grid position.

sheet.description: Sub-sheet file or sheet name on the root schematic; default is the root sheet.

dnp.description: Do not populate. Omitted: left as it is.

in_bom.description: Include in the BOM. Omitted: left as it is.

on_board.description: Include on the PCB. Omitted: left as it is.

pin.description: REF:PIN the PWR_FLAG is placed on.

name.description: Net name, used as the label text when applying.

items.description: REF:PIN, where PIN is the pin number (a pin name is accepted too).

kind.description: local = net label on this sheet; global = global label across the hierarchy.

warnings.effect: STEP/VRML/render can show a bare PCB
warnings.fix: Install KiCad 3D packages (Linux: kicad-packages3d) and set KICAD10_3DMODEL_DIR

result.description: Deterministically sorted placement measurements. All coordinates and lengths are millimetres; overlap area is mm²; density is mm/mm². JSON numbers must be finite. Missing or open outlines have error set and CLI exit 3.
